entities.summary: James Daniel Jordan is an American politician who has served in the U.S. House of Representatives as the representative for Ohio's 4th congressional district since 2007. Currently in his 10th term in the House, Jordan is a member of the Republican Party. Jim Jordan was a legal figures from Troy (b. 1964-02-17, Troy). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
